verdict.rationale: Xero documents automation features such as AI bill entry, JAX reconciliation and invoicing, and an MCP server. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review history, or rollback of automations or rules. The axis is a fair question for an automation-capable SaaS platform, so the missing evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
